## Background

<!-- CHANGE THIS -->

I have a bachelor's in computer science - what drew me to MUSA was a separate interest in urban geography. Throughout my undergrad, I would create projects in Python and R that would analyze urban data, combining both of my interests together for work in classes and as president of the local advocacy club. What I hope to work on now relates to using cutting-edge models to find new insights in large-scale urban datasets using novel methods.
